path.description: Existing regular file relative to the configured workspace root, e.g. reports/input.pdf. Absolute paths, URLs, traversal and symlinks are forbidden.
Destination relative to the configured workspace root, e.g. reports/output.pdf. Parent directories must already exist. Cannot name or alias any input.

replaceExisting.description: Allow overwriting a distinct existing destination. By default an existing destination returns OUTPUT_EXISTS. This never authorizes changing the input.

password.description: User password required to open the encrypted output. UTF-8, at most 127 bytes — the PDF specification bound, enforced in bytes so multi-byte characters count several. An intentionally empty string is valid (R6 owner-only file: opens without a password and has no content confidentiality); an omitted field prompts or fails, which is different.

ownerPassword.description: Optional owner (permissions) password with the same byte bound. When omitted a random unguessable owner password is generated — never a blank backdoor. A supplied empty string is invalid: qpdf refuses it for AES-256 because the result would open without a password.

password.description: The document's user or owner password. UTF-8, at most 127 bytes — the PDF specification bound, enforced in bytes. Supply an empty string for owner-only files that open without a password.

deepCheck.description: Also run the full stream-decoding structural check (qpdf --check); slower on large documents. Default inspection parses the object structure and reports a STREAM_DECODE_UNCHECKED warning instead.

pages.description: Strictly increasing 1-based page numbers within source bounds.
Strictly increasing 1-based page numbers within source bounds.
Strictly increasing 1-based page numbers to remove; at least one page must remain.
Output order as 1-based source page numbers. It must cover every input page exactly once.

mode.description: Explicit lossless never degrades images or rasterizes pages, including with maxOutputBytes. Lossy allows JPEG optimization and, with a target, image downsampling and eligible page rasterization. Layered requires PDFium and tries a fixed 400 DPI lossy reconstruction of eligible traced pages; jpegQuality and compressionLevel do not apply. If omitted: lossless unless compressionLevel is 2–3 or a target is supplied without a level.

jpegQuality.description: JPEG quality (0-100, default 80) when mode is lossy; rejected in lossless mode.

compressionLevel.description: Descent floor for image resampling: 1 keeps lossless structure only, 2 allows down to ~200dpi at high JPEG quality, 3 allows down to ~120dpi with stronger encoding. Alone it pins that rung; with maxOutputBytes it is the deepest rung the ladder may reach.

maxOutputBytes.description: Requested maximum output size in bytes. Explicit lossless (or compressionLevel 1) checks lossless output only. Layered checks its fixed-resolution result. With lossy or omitted mode and no level 1, the target can trigger lossy descent and eligible page rasterization.

onTargetMiss.description: When output cannot reach maxOutputBytes: bestEffort publishes the smallest achieved bytes with targetMet false and a SIZE_TARGET_UNMET warning; error fails SIZE_TARGET_UNMET (422) without publishing.

allowLargerOutput.description: Keep compressed bytes even when not smaller. Otherwise publish the validated original bytes and report outputSource original.

path.description: Relative regular-file path inside a configured workspace root; URLs, traversal and symlink escape forbidden.

techniques.description: Compression passes applied to the published candidate: flate-recompress, object-streams, resource-drop, jpeg-recompress, image-downsample, pageRasterization, layeredRasterization; empty when original bytes were published. Rasterization rebuilds eligible traced pages as images, losing vector zoom detail. Pages holding text, annotations, layers or tagged structure are not rasterized.

targetBytes.description: Echo of the requested maxOutputBytes; present only when the request set it.

targetMet.description: Whether published bytes are at or below maxOutputBytes; present only when the request set it.

path.description: Relative regular-file path inside a configured workspace root; URLs, traversal and symlink escape forbidden.

annotationCount.description: Number of entries in this page's Annots array.

hasMetadata.description: Info dictionary or catalog XMP metadata exists.

preservationEvidence.description: Optional backend comparison hashes for complete metadata, outline structure and attachment content; absent means not verified.

bookmarks.description: Canonical JSON outline structure with 1-based destination positions for selected-page comparison.

operationId.description: Requested operation ID; unknown when parsing did not resolve an operation.

ContentEngine.description: Registered engine ID. When omitted, use the first configured engine for this capability. No fallback on errors.

pages.description: Strictly increasing 1-based page numbers within source bounds.

TextBounds.description: Axis-aligned bounds in unrotated PDF default user space (x right, y up), without rebasing to the crop box. Left <= right and bottom <= top.

text.description: Plain text in engine reading order. Empty if no embedded text is found.

spans.description: Positioned text runs in engine reading order. The engine determines run segmentation and can insert whitespace into page text.

pages.description: Exactly one result per requested page, in request order.

path.description: Relative regular-file path inside a configured workspace root; URLs, traversal and symlink escape forbidden.

Preserve.description: False (default) requests best effort with omission reporting. True requires full preservation when present, or PRESERVATION_UNMET before publication. Primary document information is retained where qpdf supports it; secondary merge document information may be omitted.

x-anpdf-status: Development contract; qpdf 12.x >=12.4.2 required; only 12.4.2 qualified; strict mode requires exact; PDFium is the default text/render engine
